title: Seacrest Beach "Rosecrest" 259 Lifeguard Loop East
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from Rosemary Town Center & heart of Seacrest- Complimentary beach tram service from 9:00 am-5:45 pm every day from March 1-October 31- Professionally decorated home - 2 living rooms - 4 king bedrooms- TVs in all bedrooms & living rooms- Elevator to access all 3 floors- 5 adult bikes- Garage - Propane Grill - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This stunning home is steps away from the best dining and shopping in Seacrest and Rosemary Beach! This home has incredible accommodations for 12 guests, including 5 beautiful bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, 2 living rooms, and an in-home elevator to access all three levels.The first floor presents a beautiful primary suite, offering a plush king bed and a private en-suite bathroom with a shower and single vanity. Also on the first level is a secondary living room area, with a plush sofa and a large-mounted flat-screen television.On the second floor, a spacious open-concept layout joins the kitchen, dining, and living areas - offering guests the perfect space to relax in these common areas. The chef's kitchen features premium stainless steel appliances, a gas range, beautiful dark cabinetry, and seating for 4 guests at the breakfast bar. The adjoining dining area provides seating for 8 guests. In the nearby living room, plush furnishings - including a comfortable queen sleeper sofa - and pops of navy offer a serene and comfortable place to relax. Guests will enjoy the large, mounted flat-screen television - a great place to enjoy a favorite family movie after a long day of fun in the sun. Down the hall, a bunk room offers a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a private bathroom with a single vanity and a shower - the perfect setup for younger guests in your group!The third floor offers three additional bedrooms with large flat-screen televisions in each. The first two king guest rooms feature a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final bedroom is a stunning third-floor primary suite with a gorgeous king bed, a large mounted flat-screen television, and a private en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, a large soaking tub, and a glass-front shower.Guests in this property will love the unbeatable location - just steps away from the very best dining and shopping in both Rosemary Town Center and Seacrest. Five custom Callista Vacation Rentals adult beach cruiser bikes offer a fantastic way to explore the surrounding areas. The sugar-white sand beach is just a short walk - or complimentary tram ride - away, where you can soak in the sun and let the sparkling emerald waters wash your cares away. Guests can enjoy two nearby community pools - one offering heated waters in the winter and the other featuring a family-friendly, zero-entry pool and splash pad.The best of Rosemary and Seacrest are right outside your door at 259 Lifeguard Loop East. Book your getaway in this incredible home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:-Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerTHIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with separate Shower and Tub*This home is only allotted 12 wristbands.
